transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because I've kind of started planning my days around not using elevators. 

It's getting to be a bit much. I mean, I'm taking five flights of stairs at home every day just to avoid them. And it's actually starting to affect my work now—I recently turned down a training workshop just because it was in a high-rise. I even had to stop doing visits with one of my older computer students because his building doesn't really have another option to get up there. 

So, yeah, I figured I should probably talk to someone about it before it gets worse.
Is your fear limited to elevators?

Yeah, it's pretty much just elevators. I mean, I know an elevator in a big office block is probably completely safe. But when I look at those old doors in my apartment building, or the ones at my work, my mind just... it treats it like I’m about to get trapped in there, or like the whole thing is going to drop. Even though part of me knows that sounds over the top. So, yeah, it's just the elevators.
